description: Bitcoin mempool pressure state and projected next blocks. Class (low/normal/high/extreme) is determined deterministically: extreme if next block median fee >= 50 sat/vB or backlog >= 150 vMB; high if >= 20 sat/vB or >= 60 vMB; normal if >= 3 sat/vB or >= 10 vMB; low otherwise. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

maxBlocks.description: Maximum projected blocks to return (1-10, default 8)
